name: Chicken Chasseur (French Hunter's Chicken)
method: braise (Dutch oven / stovetop, browned then simmered)
note: In-band (459 cal / 13g carbs / 36g protein), a French chicken-thigh hunter's braise in a WHITE-wine + fresh-crushed-tomato + tarragon sauce, no starch base. Kept over its batch-mate creamy-garlic-parmesan-mushroom-chicken-skillet because it is the more distinctive of the two chicken candidates: it widens the American-skewed catalog with a French classic and is TOMATO-based, so distinct from every accepted creamy chicken dish (creamy-tuscan-chicken-skillet, chicken-marsala-skillet's marsala reduction) and from accepted french-chicken-fricassee (a cream braise, not tomato). Cross-lane check against fresh accepted-slugs.json: the only French chicken braise accepted is fricassee (cream) - chasseur's tomato/tarragon sauce is a recognizably different dinner. Chicken is already the joint-largest lane (8), so I took only one chicken from this batch to protect the beef/chicken/turkey/pork balance.
